environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 with origin security group restricting inbound TCP/8080 to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. A CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) is configured with a custom origin pointing to the EC2 private IP. CloudFront behaviors require signed URLs using a trusted key group (key-group-id: kg-9f8e7d6c) with RSA-2048 keypair; unsigned requests receive 403. The /oauth/callback path pattern is included in the behavior requiring signature validation. CloudFront origin custom header X-Origin-Verify is set to a 64-char random secret, and the Actix-web service validates this header on all routes (middleware rejects requests missing the header). The EC2 instance has no public IP; only the CloudFront distribution can route to it via the VPC origin configuration.
